metadata.note: Skill teardown of skills/make/hai/SKILL.md (SOURCE-SNAPSHOT SHA-256 ef01252f…; supervisor's episode.source_sha256 95726218…). `hai` is the AUDIENCE-PRESET that FORKS any reel/lecture/book into a new `hai-` sibling directory — the canonical source is never modified. Teaches: the six-step flow (SCAFFOLD · REWRITE PLAIN · optional tangent · CLI EXERCISE · HAI OUTRO · VERIFY), the non-destructive fork posture (brand_variant.py refuses to overwrite without --force), the Plain register's REQUIRED 'when NOT to and where it fails' line, the five-part CLI exercise schema (ask · output · change · output2 · next_step, BUILD vs RESEARCH), and batch mode's scope (scaffolds every reel and lecture in a book but leaves Steps 2–6 per-video). Falsifiability beat surfaces a real disagreement across three source files about which Kokoro voice HAI uses (SKILL.md af_kore vs brand_variant.py af_bella vs brands/hai.md am_onyx after ElevenLabs was removed 2026-09-03). This teardown IS a claude-liam reel — Kokoro am_onyx, Liam sign-off, ClaudeTitleOutro locked to @NikBearBrown per OUTRO-LOCK — because the falsifiability beat's OWN evidence is that outro follows channel. No paid capability required; no captions; brand_variant.py demoed live on a synthetic fixture reel (see demo/). Portrait companion — native 9:16 layouts (not a center-crop of the landscape master). channel_title metadata deliberately omitted — its compile-overlay bleeds past portrait safe.b (feedback_channel_title_portrait_bleed). Three SkillTeardown*916 wrappers plus the BrutalistHesitantWriter portrait-aware scale patch are copies of the guests episode's scene-source (credited in SOURCES.md), registered in this isolated toolkit's Root.tsx for this run.

beats.narration_text: The easy read — the one the phrase brand variant invites — is that hai reformats an existing reel. It does not. Nothing is reformatted. Nothing is overwritten. Hai forks the sheet into a new hai- directory beside it, and every downstream change happens there. The source stays byte-identical.

beats.role_note: The pipeline — the required six-step flow. Input: any reel/lecture. Output: a hai- sibling with the Plain rewrite, one CLI exercise, and the HAI outro.
beats.narration_text: The flow is fixed. Six steps. Scaffold first — deterministic, no spend, no writes to the source. Then rewrite every beat's narration in the Plain register. Optional — at most one Irreducibly-Human tangent — a bounded aside, most reels get none. Second-to-last, insert one CLI worked exercise the viewer can actually paste and run. Last beat, replace with the Humanitarians AI outro. Then verify the ending order. Same shape every episode.

beats.role_note: Design decision 1 — NON-DESTRUCTIVE FORK. brand_variant.py won't overwrite without --force; SKILL.md's 'source files are never modified' standing rule.
beats.narration_text: First design decision, and it sets the safety posture. Every hai run writes to a new directory beside the source and never modifies beat_sheet.json, build scripts, or media. The scaffolder even refuses to overwrite its own output — you get an already-exists, use dash-dash force error, not a silent clobber. The doctrine reads: source files are never modified. The consequence: hai is safe to run against a canonical reel mid-production. Your original cut keeps rendering. The humanitarians cut branches off.

props.heading: Non-destructive fork.
props.body: Every hai run writes to a NEW sibling directory. Source beat_sheet.json, build scripts, and media are never modified. brand_variant.py exits with an 'already exists — use --force' error rather than clobber its own output. Safe to run against a canonical reel mid-production.
props.quote: Source files (beat_sheet.json, build scripts, media) are never modified.

beats.role_note: Design decision 2 — PLAIN REGISTER. Not a tone, a checklist. The 'when NOT to and where it fails' line is REQUIRED.
beats.narration_text: Second decision. Plain register is not a softer tone — it is a checklist. Every rewritten beat leads with method, states when to use it, and, required, states when NOT to and where it fails. That third line is the AI main event for busy practitioners. It is not hedging. It is the diagnostic they need. If your rewrite has no failure mode named, you have not done the register. You have just changed adjectives.

props.heading: Plain register.
props.body: The rewrite is a three-line checklist: (1) METHOD — what it is, what it produces; (2) WHEN TO USE — the decision trigger; (3) WHEN NOT TO and where it fails. Line 3 is REQUIRED. A rewrite that skips it has not done the register — it has changed adjectives.
props.quote: Required: when NOT to and where it fails — the AI main event for busy practitioners. This is not hedging; it is the diagnostic the audience needs. Do not skip.

beats.role_note: FALSIFIABILITY — a real disagreement across three source files about the HAI Kokoro voice. Trust brands/hai.md; override the scaffolder; log the discrepancy.
beats.narration_text: Falsifiability. Read the sources together and you find a real disagreement about the HAI voice. SKILL.md says af_kore. The runtime scaffolder writes af_bella. And the current brand spec at brands slash hai dot md says am_onyx, after ElevenLabs was removed in September. Three files, three voices. This teardown IS a claude-liam reel, so we ship am_onyx with Liam's sign-off. But if you build a real HAI cut this week, treat brands slash hai dot md as the source of truth, override the scaffolder's voice field, and log the discrepancy. That is what the register asks of you: name the failure mode plainly.

beats.role_note: VERDICT — artifact card. Recapitulates the skill in six lines.
beats.narration_text: The verdict. Hai is a non-destructive fork with a checklist, not a re-skin. Six steps, one sibling directory beside the source. The Plain register is a diagnostic — the when NOT to line is mandatory. The CLI exercise must actually run. Batch mode scaffolds every reel and lecture in a book, but the register rewrite is still per-video. And the voice field is contested across three source files — trust brands slash hai dot md, override in the sheet, log the discrepancy.
